Rain to tap in 8 steps 💧
Welsh Water screens out debris, uses a coagulant to clump tiny particles into flocs, settles or floats them off, then filters through fine sand. Next it corrects the pH and disinfects with chlorine (some sites add UV), stores it in enclosed service reservoirs and sends it on, usually by gravity. Over 800 million litres a day reach over 1.4 million homes and businesses, with some 300,000 water tests a year.
